description: Extract the PipeWire-specific capture interface into a platform-agnostic `CaptureBackend` trait in helper/src/capture/. The trait must cover: open stream, frame callback (with GPU buffer handle), dynamic resolution change, and graceful stop. PipeWire becomes one impl behind `#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]`. This unblocks all Windows capture work.
title: Platform capture trait abstraction
